lines.text: Asaph asks God not to be silent and says His enemies rage.
With cunning the enemies plot with one mind to erase Israel as a nation and form an alliance against God.
Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, Tyre and Egypt join the alliance, lending strength to the sons of Lot.
Asaph asks God to treat the enemies as He treated Midian, Sisera and Jabin at the River Jordan.
Asaph asks God to cover their faces with shame so they seek His name and know He is Most High.
